title: Technical meanings of play and Legion
new_text: In trigger conditions, 'play' means resolving an item on the chain. In other conditions and effects that check whether a card was played, including Legion, it means finalizing the item. In other verb uses, it means placing an item on the chain and queuing it for finalization.
explanation: These three transitional meanings govern whether play triggers happen, whether Legion is active, and when instructions that play a card have occurred.
